addr: 2H3C+Q2H, 14th Cross Rd, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: Ordinary day no issues with the parking. If there's is any function on week days and Saturday it will be Very big problem for parking. Unless the auditorium is so good.

Its a quaint little auditorium tucked away in the bylanes of Malleshwaram. Awesome sound system, comfortable seating and a very generous stage and backstage make it an ideal place for conducting musical evenings. Parking is limited and one needs to park in areas in and around the hall.

Lovely place. Lot of activities happen here.
Lighting is excellent. Audio is very good as well.
Place is old but decently maintained.
There are no parking space.
